nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Cursor IDE session source, defining the cursoride- session id prefix and wiring together the db, disk_reads, history, helpers, io, models, and summaries submodules.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Conversion helpers that turn raw Cursor IDE bubble/composer data into canonical activity chunks: text cleanup, timestamp normalization, tool-call/result normalization, and subagent/question-answer linking.

nodes.name: is_listable_cursor_session
nodes.summary: Determines whether a cached Cursor IDE session row should be shown as a top-level listable session (vs. a hidden child/subagent session).

nodes.name: cache_row_to_session_row
nodes.summary: Converts a cached database row into the CursorIdeSessionRow shape returned by the session list API.

nodes.name: cursor_touched_files_from_states
nodes.summary: Extracts the list of files touched by a composer from its original-file-state snapshots.

nodes.name: cursor_file_uri_to_path
nodes.summary: Converts a Cursor file:// URI into a plain filesystem path.

nodes.name: cursor_workspace_metadata_from_parts
nodes.summary: Builds workspace metadata (repo path, branch) from tracked-git-repo and workspace-identifier fragments.

nodes.name: repo_name_from_path
nodes.summary: Derives a short repository display name from a filesystem path.

nodes.name: epoch_ms_to_iso
nodes.summary: Converts an epoch-milliseconds timestamp into an ISO-8601 string.

nodes.name: composer_source_updated_at
nodes.summary: Computes the effective 'source updated at' timestamp for a composer, combining metadata and bubble order.

nodes.name: parse_iso_to_epoch_ms
nodes.summary: Parses an ISO-8601 timestamp string into epoch milliseconds.

nodes.name: duration_between_iso_ms
nodes.summary: Computes the millisecond duration between two ISO-8601 timestamps.

nodes.name: preview_text
nodes.summary: Truncates text to a short preview suitable for list display.

nodes.name: normalize_created_at
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw created-at value (numeric or string) into an ISO-8601 timestamp.

nodes.name: enforce_monotonic_created_at
nodes.summary: Adjusts a sequence of activity chunk timestamps to be strictly monotonically increasing.

nodes.name: fallback_turn_created_at
nodes.summary: Computes a fallback created-at timestamp for a turn when explicit bubble timestamps are missing.

nodes.name: build_fallback_user_chunk
nodes.summary: Builds a placeholder user-message activity chunk when the original bubble content is unavailable.

nodes.name: build_unloaded_turn_placeholder_chunk
nodes.summary: Builds a placeholder activity chunk representing a turn whose full content has not yet been loaded.

nodes.name: bubbles_to_chunks
nodes.summary: Converts an ordered list of Cursor IDE bubbles into canonical activity chunks for a session.

nodes.name: cursor_subagent_prompt_bubble_to_chunk
nodes.summary: Converts a subagent prompt bubble into a canonical activity chunk.

nodes.name: user_bubble_to_chunk
nodes.summary: Converts a user-message bubble into a canonical user-message activity chunk.

nodes.name: assistant_text_bubble_to_chunk
nodes.summary: Converts an assistant text-response bubble into a canonical activity chunk.

nodes.name: assistant_tool_bubble_to_chunk
nodes.summary: Converts an assistant tool-use bubble into a canonical tool-call activity chunk.

nodes.name: normalize_args_for_canonical
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw Cursor tool-call arguments into the app's canonical tool-call argument shape.

nodes.name: normalize_result_for_canonical
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw Cursor tool-call result into the app's canonical tool-result shape.

nodes.name: link_subagent_session
nodes.summary: Links a subagent tool call to the child session it spawned.

nodes.name: resolve_ask_question_answers
nodes.summary: Resolves a Cursor 'ask question' tool call against its recorded user answer.

nodes.name: build_cursor_edit_diff
nodes.summary: Builds a unified-diff-like structure from a Cursor edit tool call's old and new content.

nodes.name: move_string_field
nodes.summary: Moves a string field from one key to another within a JSON object, if present.

nodes.name: cursor_tool_name_to_canonical
nodes.summary: Maps a raw Cursor tool name to the app's canonical tool-name enum/string.

nodes.name: parse_inner_json
nodes.summary: Parses a JSON-encoded string value nested inside another JSON structure.

nodes.name: merge_cursor_additional_data
nodes.summary: Merges Cursor's 'additionalData' payload fields into a normalized tool result.

nodes.name: enrich_tool_result
nodes.summary: Enriches a normalized tool result payload using data from its originating tool-former-data record.

nodes.name: history.rs
nodes.summary: Public history-loading API for the Cursor IDE source: paginated session listing plus full-refresh, initial-window, and turn-window loading strategies used for progressive session detail loading.

nodes.name: CursorIdeSessionRow
nodes.summary: Row shape for a single Cursor IDE session as returned in a paginated session list.

nodes.name: CursorIdeSessionPage
nodes.summary: Paginated page of Cursor IDE session rows with a next-page cursor.

nodes.name: CursorIdeInitialWindow
nodes.summary: Initial slice of a Cursor IDE session's activity used for fast first paint before the full history loads.

nodes.name: CursorIdeFullRefresh
nodes.summary: Full recomputed activity history and metadata for a Cursor IDE session.

nodes.name: CursorIdeTurnWindow
nodes.summary: A single conversation turn's activity chunks loaded on demand for a Cursor IDE session.

nodes.name: list_cursor_ide_sessions_paginated
nodes.summary: Lists cached Cursor IDE sessions in a paginated page for the sidebar.

nodes.name: load_history_for_session
nodes.summary: Loads the full canonical activity history for a Cursor IDE session id.

nodes.name: load_full_refresh_for_session
nodes.summary: Performs a full refresh load of a Cursor IDE session's metadata and activity from source.

nodes.name: load_initial_window_for_session
nodes.summary: Loads an initial window of recent activity for a Cursor IDE session to enable fast first paint.

nodes.name: load_turn_window_for_session
nodes.summary: Loads the activity chunks for a single conversation turn of a Cursor IDE session on demand.

nodes.name: io.rs
nodes.summary: Low-level SQLite access for Cursor IDE's global state.vscdb and workspace conversation-index databases: opening connections and loading raw bubble/composer/content-blob rows.

nodes.name: open_cursor_db
nodes.summary: Opens Cursor IDE's global state.vscdb SQLite database in read-only mode.

nodes.name: cursor_global_storage_dir
nodes.summary: Resolves the OS-specific Cursor IDE global storage directory path.

nodes.name: open_cursor_conversation_index_db
nodes.summary: Opens a workspace's Cursor conversation-index SQLite database in read-only mode.

nodes.name: load_complete_bubble_order
nodes.summary: Loads the complete ordered list of bubble ids for a composer, merging header order with any missing bubbles.

nodes.name: load_composer_for_order
nodes.summary: Loads a composer's raw metadata row needed to resolve its bubble order.

nodes.name: load_bubbles_by_id
nodes.summary: Batch-loads raw bubble rows by id from the Cursor IDE database for a given bubble order.

nodes.name: load_content_blob
nodes.summary: Loads a single large content blob by id from the Cursor IDE database.

nodes.name: models.rs
nodes.summary: Serde data-model structs for raw Cursor IDE database rows (bubbles, composers, tool-former data, git/workspace metadata) plus a small non-cryptographic StableFingerprint hash builder used for change detection.
nodes.languageNotes: StableFingerprint implements a simple streaming hasher (write_str/write_i64/write_usize/write_bytes/finish_hex) to produce a stable hex fingerprint independent of Rust's randomized default hasher.

nodes.name: OrderedBubble
nodes.summary: A bubble id paired with its type and raw JSON payload, in conversation order.

nodes.name: RawBubble
nodes.summary: Raw deserialized shape of a single Cursor IDE conversation bubble row.

nodes.name: RawToolFormerData
nodes.summary: Raw deserialized tool invocation metadata (name, args, status, result) attached to a bubble.

nodes.name: RawComposerHeader
nodes.summary: Minimal header shape used to read a composer's bubble id/type without the full payload.

nodes.name: RawComposerForOrder
nodes.summary: Composer fields needed to reconstruct bubble ordering and workspace/git metadata.

nodes.name: RawCursorOriginalFileState
nodes.summary: Raw snapshot of a file's state before an edit, used to compute touched files.

nodes.name: RawCursorSubagentInfo
nodes.summary: Raw metadata identifying a subagent invocation and its parent composer.

nodes.name: CursorComposerContext
nodes.summary: Parsed composer context wrapping optional subagent info.

nodes.name: RawTrackedGitRepo
nodes.summary: Raw tracked git repository entry (path and branches) from composer metadata.

nodes.name: RawTrackedGitBranch
nodes.summary: Raw tracked git branch name entry.

nodes.name: RawWorkspaceIdentifier
nodes.summary: Raw workspace identifier wrapping a URI.

nodes.name: RawWorkspaceUri
nodes.summary: Raw workspace URI with filesystem path and generic path fields.

nodes.name: CursorWorkspaceMetadata
nodes.summary: Resolved workspace metadata (repo path, branch) derived from raw git/workspace fragments.

nodes.name: CursorIdeTurnSummary
nodes.summary: Cached summary of a single conversation turn (span, timing) used to avoid reprocessing.

nodes.name: StableFingerprint
nodes.summary: Minimal streaming hash builder producing a stable hex fingerprint for change-detection signatures.
